claim.claim-text: 1. 2-chloro-2'-deoxyadenosine, known as cladribine, or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, for use in the treatment or amelioration of an autoimmune muscular disorder.

2. A pharmaceutical composition comprising 2-chloro-2'-deoxyadenosine, known as cladribine and one or more pharmaceutically acceptable excipients for use in the treatment or amelioration of an autoimmune muscular disorder.
3. The cladribine or composition of claim 1 or 2, for use in a neuromuscular junction disorder caused by pathogenic autoantibodies to components of the postsynaptic muscle endplate.
4. The cladribine or composition of claim 1 or 2, for use in the treatment of autoimmune and neonatal myasthenia gravis, Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome, or neuromyotonia.
5. The cladribine or composition of claim 1 or 2, for use in the treatment of myasthenia gravis.
6. The composition of any of claims 2-5 in unit dosage form, comprising 1-20 mg per unit dose.
7. The composition of any of claims 2-5 in unit dosage form, comprising 2.5-15 mg per unit dose.
8. The composition of any of claims 2-5 in unit dosage form, comprising 8-12 mg per unit dose
9. The composition of any of claims 2-8, which is a tablet, a capsule or a liquid formulation.
10. The composition of any of claims 2-8, presented in a sterile liquid formulation suitable for injection.
11. The composition of any of claims 2-10, for administration daily as a single dose.

12. Cladribine or the composition of any of claims 2-11, for administration in an effective amount determined as the effective cumulative amount of cladribine administered on between 1 and 20 dosing days, distributed over between 1 and 16 weeks, that results in a reduction of CD3+ T cells of between 30 and 80%, relative to pre-treatment levels.

13. The cladribine or composition of claim 12, for administration in an effective amount determined as the effective cumulative amount of cladribine administered on between 1 and 20 dosing days, distributed over between 5 and 10 weeks, that results in a reduction of CD3+ T cells of between 40 and 60% relative to pre-treatment levels.

14. The cladribine or composition of any preceding claim for use in an effective cumulative dose or amount of from 0.1 to 6 mg cladribine per kilogram of patient body weight (mg/kg) in the medicament is taken over a period of from one to two years.

15. The cladribine or composition of any of claims 1-13 for use in an effective cumulative dose or amount of from 0.2 to 2.5 mg/kg cladribine of patient body weight (mg/kg) in the medicament is taken over a period of from one to two years.

16. A method of treating or ameliorating myasthenia gravis in a subject suffering from the disease comprising administering to the subject, or patient, a pharmaceutical composition comprising an effective amount of 2-chloro-2'-deoxyadenosine (cladribine), or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof.
17. Use of 2-chloro-2'-deoxyadenosine (cladribine), or a pharmaceutically acceptable salt thereof, in the preparation of a medicament for the treatment or amelioration of myasthenia gravis.
